source.quote: דמי ניהול/טיפול פקדון ני"ע ₪ 75 לחודש 0.15% מינימום

rate.notes: '0.15%, מינימום ₪ 75 לחודש', charged once a month ('אחת לחודש'), computed on the portfolio value including financial assets and fund units. The tariff does not say whether 0.15% is a monthly or an annual rate; recorded per the monthly charging period as printed, unconfirmed. The tariff prints no exemption of makam or money-market funds from custody; the bank ban (BRK-17) does not apply to a non-bank member, and no rule limits its custody fee on them (BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26), so no excludes are recorded.

availability.note: Printed "אחת לחודש, 0.15% מינימום ₪ 75 לחודש", p.2. As a monthly rate this is 1.8% a year; the document does not say. Its about page (library 22f5007bbc67cda4, as-invest.co.il/trade/about/, read 2026-10-31) says "מחירים אטרקטיביים במיוחד, ללא דמי משמרת" with no condition; its joining offer (library e7f582848e27b188, /trade/trading_benefits/) waives "דמי ניהול" for new customers, and the offer's terms (library e99ac8ffb6741bb3, p.2) give it to an account with frequent trades, at the company's discretion. Neither states the ordinary customer's rate. Would settle it: the fee annex of the account agreement (not published), or the company's written answer.
